'''SEC-M droid''' was a [[MSE-6 series repair droid/Legends|Mouse droid]] model used by the [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. In [[3643 BBY]] [[Cipher Nine]] used one SEC-M droid to plant a tracker onto the ship of the [[Eagle's network]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
SEC-M droid appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Imperial Agent class mission "Cleaning Up the Mess" on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]].
